scope: Final numerical adjudication of the sole v209.1 mismatch. The formal arrays, original v209 protocol, camera rosters, zero-start CGLS K16, accuracy gates, summaries, costs, and scientific decision order remain unchanged and are not regenerated.

numerical_question.observed_mismatch: v209.1 independently reproduced fields, observations, metrics, summaries, gates, calls, geometry, and decisions. Its only numerical mismatch divided two tiny recursive residuals by the tiny formal residual norm, producing an unstable relative scale.
numerical_question.adjudication_equation: For every arm, rig, and frame, independently rebuild b and A, rerun CGLS K16, and check the defining equation r = b - A x.
numerical_question.stable_normalization: Each residual difference is divided by max(||b||_2, 1e-30), where b is the independently regenerated physical observation for that same cell.
